messages.speaker: client
messages.text:
Hi [FREELANCER_NAME_001]
Hi,

[FREELANCER_NAME_002] a small nonprofit organization ([URL_001]) launching a YouTube channel, and we need a thumbnail for our first video. Ideally, we’d receive it by the start of next week (monday or tuesday). If you’re able to help, I can send the video, a google doc containing thumbnail ideas and guidance, and a thumbnail I attempted myself. We’d prefer that the thumbnail contain no AI assets, though minor AI-assisted edits such as generative fill in photoshop are probably fine. Would you be able to help?

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text:
Hi [CLIENT_NAME_001], I Believe I can help with this.
We can discuss it further whenever you’re available.

You can also send over the details about your channel and content, along with the previous thumbnail you attempted to make yourself.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text:
My thoughts about the thumbnail are in this document: [URL_002]

You can find the current version of the video here: [URL_003]

I’ve also attached the thumbnail I made, although I think it’s only okay.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: yes, there are things we can improve, and I can have the thumbnail completed within 24-48hrs. does that sound good?

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: could you also send any competitors or designs you like? if there are brand guidelines you’d like me to follow, please share those too.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: also, send me the title you currently have in mind for the video. I can provide my own title Variations alongside yours so that we can A/B Test them as well.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text:
I have One Question: I don’t mind working on Hourly, but Sometimes it’s difficult to focus on the work while also watching the clock. Would you mind switching to a milestone based arrangement if you’re okay with that?

please share your thougths so we can begin asap.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: Okay I modified the offer!

messages.speaker: client
messages.text:
> could you send over any competitors or designs you like, as well as any brand guidelines you want me to follow?

Would it work for you if I point you to the google doc, since it contains all of my thoughts?

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: let me go through it Quickly, [CLIENT_NAME_001]

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text:
I Believe I now have all the details regarding the video, your ideas, the examples, and your thoughts.

One last thing: should I Extract your image directly from the video, or do you have any headshot pictures available?

messages.speaker: client
messages.text:
> please send the video title you have in mind. I can also suggest my own title Variations alongside yours so we can A/B Test them.

[FREELANCER_NAME_002] planning to A/B test these three titles:

How we traced a bot-run newsroom back to OpenAI’s super PAC.
We caught OpenAI’s super PAC funding a bot-run newsroom.
The news site using AI bots as reporters.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: Yeah, taking my image directly from the video would work for me, if that’s okay!

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text:
we can do that, although I generally prefer separately taken images because they have better Quality and give us more options to work with across different poses.

However, If that isn’t possible, I Can pull images from the video itself, and we can replace them if you don’t like the result.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: Okay, great—thank you! For future videos, we could potentially take more headshot-style images.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: but for this one, using screenshots from the video should be good for now

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text:
one more thing: I Do use Ai, not to create the assets themselves, but sometimes to generate certain elements or change somethings in photos with Generative Ai or other Ai's. I always make sure everything appears natural rather than looking like it was made by Ai.

I wanted to be transparent with you about the ways I use Ai.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: Sure

messages.speaker: client
messages.text:
> perhaps generate certain elements or modify somethings in photos with Generative Ai or other Ai's while ensuring the result looks natural

I’d prefer that you not do any of those things.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: I think our acceptable limit for AI editing would be something like using photoshop's generative fill to remove a distracting prop in the background.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: However, we’d prefer not to have any newly generated assets or wholesale changes made to the photograph.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: Could I show you before/after examples of some images to help give you confidence?

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: if you don’t want that, then we won’t do it

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: Yeah, I’m fine with you sharing them, and I’m curious about your process. If you’re uploading images to ChatGPT/Gemini/Midjourney/etc. and instructing it to make changes, we’d probably want to veto that.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: Sorry about that—[FREELANCER_NAME_002] an AI industry watchdog group, and many of our supporters are concerned about issues such as the impact AI has on artists. Because of that, we try not to use AI-generated assets or AI tools to make coarse edits across an entire photo.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: first things first, I Will not use Ai, and I’ll make sure all assets are original and taken or created in photoshop.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: Yeah, unfortunately I think these examples involve the AI generating content wholesale, even when it’s based on existing photos. That’s the kind of thing we’d prefer not to have done. I hope that works for you!

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: Understood, [CLIENT_NAME_001]. I will not use AI for wholesale content generation, and every asset will be made manually in Photoshop. The only AI use would be limited to Photoshop's Generative Fill for minor touch-ups, never to create complete assets. Please let me know whether that works for you.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: Great, that works. Thank you!

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: Perfect—thank you, [CLIENT_NAME_001]! I’ll begin working on it and deliver the thumbnail within 48hrs. Does that sound good?

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text:
Hey [CLIENT_NAME_001], Hope you're doing well. Just a quick update:

The concept is complete, and now it's only a matter of implementing everything. One issue, though: I've developed a pretty high fever, and I'm being admitted for an IV drip. If discharged today, I'll send the final thumbnail variation tonight; otherwise, it'll definitely be tomorrow.

Once that's finished, if you'd like any revisions, please let me know. I’m happy to continue refining it until you're completely satisfied with the result.

Best, [FREELANCER_NAME_001]

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: Hey [CLIENT_NAME_001], Hope you’re doing well. I’ve made these two Concepts and also have a sillouhette version in mind, which I’ll share shortly. In the meantime, please share your thoughts on these, and if any Revisions is Required, I’m happy to help.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text:
Hi [CLIENT_NAME_001], I haven’t heard from you for a while regarding your feedback on the existing thumbnail design or any details for a new thumbnail, so I wanted to follow up in case you missed my earlier message.
I’m looking forward to hearing from you soon.

best, [FREELANCER_NAME_001]

messages.speaker: client
messages.text:
HI [FREELANCER_NAME_001],

I’m very sorry for replying so late, and thank you for creating these! We ultimately chose a different thumbnail for the video, but I appreciate your assistance. I’ll pay now and include a bonus because the payment was late on our end.

Thank you so much for all your help!

[CLIENT_NAME_001]
